title: AgentCommand
description: Canonical command intake object for assigning repo-based work to FnB OS V1 agents.

created_by.description: Command author. Examples: Owner, ChatGPT, AGT-01

assigned_builder.description: Builder agent or role assigned to execute the command. Example: Claude Code

assigned_reviewer.description: Reviewer agent or role assigned to verify the output. Example: Codex

owner_request.description: Plain-language description of what the Owner or ChatGPT wants done.

scope_files.description: Exact file paths or folders the Builder is allowed to create or modify.

forbidden_actions.description: Explicit list of actions the Builder must not take.

acceptance_criteria.description: Specific, testable conditions that define DONE.

output_required.description: Artifacts the Builder must produce (files, patches, command output).

review_required.description: If true, output must be reviewed before Owner approval.

approval_required.description: If true, Owner must explicitly approve before commit.

handoff_required.description: If true, Builder must update handoff files before BUILDER_DONE.

log_required.description: If true, Builder must append to PHASE_LOG.md before BUILDER_DONE.

blocked_reason.description: Required when status is BLOCKED. Describes what is missing.

review_notes.description: Reviewer notes on REVIEW_PASS or REVIEW_FAIL.
